message: No detected input validation: The code reads the CSV via read_dataset() and calls drop_nans/drop_cols/drop_unique for cleanup, but there are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from a local file path only; there is no remote fetch, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed anywhere in the visible code.
No detected label flipping detection: The code only drops NaN values and unused columns; there is no check for label distribution anomalies, expected label ranges, or label-noise detection tools.

No detected data poisoning defenses: Data preparation only performs column dropping (drop_cols), NaN removal (drop_nans), and deduplication (drop_unique) with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious input filtering.

No detected model integrity verification: The code constructs models directly from scikit-learn classes (LinearRegression, Ridge, Lasso, SVR, RandomForestRegressor, MLPRegressor) without loading any serialized/pretrained weights, so there is no integrity verification mechanism present.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distributions, class balance, or anomalous training samples before or during training; the pipeline only splits data and fits regressors directly.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used; standard sklearn regressors are used without any privacy mechanisms.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (RMSE, R2, R2-classic) are computed and a train/test split is performed, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and no structural isolation preventing leakage between train and test sets beyond the split logic itself.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads the dataset and drops NaNs/unique counties but performs no shape, range, or schema validation on inference inputs before passing them to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The inference path computes predictions and metrics but applies no NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds on the model's output values before returning or logging them.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular regression pipeline (crop yield prediction), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
